courseCorrections.HCBGATE101: Establishes biomolecules,cells,membranes,metabolism,genetics,gene expression and biotechnology foundations through experimental-paper appraisal. It does not supply full organ physiology or chemical engineering.
courseCorrections.DISGATE102: Develops single-variable limits,differentiation,optimisation,series,integration and differential equations,with Mathematica and a dynamic-model project. Linear algebra is supplied separately;chemical thermodynamics is not taught.
courseCorrections.DISDATA212: Develops digital image representation,filtering,segmentation,features,tracking and recognition in Python/OpenCV,with benchmarking. These methods can support biological-image analysis;medical acquisition hardware or a microscopy project is not guaranteed.
courseCorrections.GOSPHIL212: Develops normative theories,moral argument and independent ethical essays. This is complementary preparation for responsible scientific choices,not a prescribed biotechnology-ethics or future-generations case sequence.
courseCorrections.HCBLIFE214: Provides actual wet-lab biochemistry,microbiology and genetics: blood/protein analysis,aseptic culture,bacterial transformation,GFPproduction/purification,DNA/PCR/restriction methods and basic database bioinformatics. This is substantial practical biotechnology; it does not reproduce multiple staged external labs.
courseCorrections.HCBLIFE311: Studies molecular pathology,genetic variation/diagnosis,gene-based treatment and cell manipulation. A research-grant proposal develops hypotheses,method choice,controls,feasibility and budget; no additional gene-engineering wet-lab practice is inferred.
